rationale: The papers 'The Role of Disk Winds in the Evolution and Dispersal of Protoplanetary Disks' (2203.10068), 'High Resolution Parameter Study of the Vertical Shear Instability' (2008.09006), and 'Kinematic Structures in Planet-Forming Disks' (2203.09528) investigate specific physical processes in protoplanetary disks that could reconcile observations and influence disk evolution, contributing substantive new evidence but not fully settling the question.
